prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one complete full-bleed portrait 2:3 tarot illustration, Four of Cups. The first 1 reference image(s) are exact Dragon Quest character identity/costume references; the LAST is ONLY the approved deck ink/color/texture style, not a scene or person to copy.
Scene and exact characters: Actual DQVII Maribel: curly reddish hair under orange hood, long green/orange sleeveless overcoat over dark red dress, orange sleeves, brown boots. She sits thoughtfully beneath a large tree, arms loosely folded, a bored inward-looking expression. Exactly FOUR golden chalices: THREE clearly spaced on ground in a row before her and ONE held out by a soft cloud-hand at her side. Nothing else shaped like a cup. Calm garden, green hills, emotional pause. Reference includes writing/frame; ignore all text and frame.
Shared deck art direction: faithfully drawn Akira Toriyama Dragon Quest characters, clean confident black ink outlines, expressive recognizable faces, crisp hand-painted cel color blocks, restrained shadows and a subtle watercolor-paper grain matching the approved illustration. Original illustration, NOT a 3D screenshot, product photograph, plush, collage or card mockup. Full-bleed single cohesive artwork edge to edge, mobile-readable clear silhouettes and large key symbols.
Hard constraints: no title, no typography, no letters or numerals, no UI, no watermark/logo, no borders or card frame. Any writing, decorative labels, copyright line, duplicate background portraits or layout boxes on reference sheets must NOT appear. Preserve actual named DQ characters, hairstyle/clothing/colors, not generic original substitutes. Keep the stated number of tarot objects exact; avoid incidental extra cups/swords/coins/wands. Do not mix in characters from other franchises.
visual_review: Actual Maribel identity with orange hood, red curls and green/red outfit; three cups on ground plus one cloud-hand cup, exactly four, no text/frame and consistent portrait style.
